message: `body.linear_velocity` belongs to the physics subsystem and is read-only.
notes: a velocity is read as of the last completed tick
help: set it with `set_linear_velocity(v)`, or change it with `apply_impulse(v)`

message: `body.angular_velocity` belongs to the physics subsystem and is read-only.
notes: the angular velocity is read as of the last completed tick; v0.1 has no command that sets it
